accepted.prompt: Create a clean flat graphic animation sprite sheet on SOLID PURE WHITE paper. A tall white page, 4 columns by 6 rows of isolated opaque turquoise eye symbols. Twenty-four symbols total. White occupies every empty area, including the holes inside the symbols. Match the flat ink appearance of these three white reference sheets. Render all ink as uniform solid #54E2D8 with crisp rounded edges. No visual effects or lighting. The references are original eye symbols; improve their blink articulation and make eight distinct cels per eye type. Output portrait 1536x2304 with even square cells of 384px. Each glyph roughly210px wide, 24px uniform stroke. Every glyph horizontal center at cell x192. Lower-lid bottom fixed at cell y280. Read cells left to right in each two-row block. TOP TWO ROWS: round open ring with small gap on the left, from reference1. Pose order: open ring,85% open,50% open,15% open,closed shallow U lid,25% open,70% open,open ring. Keep width consistent; upper eyelid drops into lower lid while the base stays still; the intermediate eyes are connected on the right. MIDDLE TWO ROWS: e-shaped loop/crossbar eye from reference2. Same opening percentages. The upper tiny loop compresses and its crossbar merges into the lower lid, always ONE CONNECTED stroke shape, including reopening. 15% and25% open should show only a small white opening with two close strokes, unlike a full open loop. Closed is a single shallow U lid. BOTTOM TWO ROWS: upward arch eye from reference3. Subtle squeeze keeping the same upward arch direction throughout and same210px width. Heights75,67,49,30,22,37,60,75px respectively, redraw curves with steady24px ink thickness; no inversion into a downward U. Rest and final poses match in each block. Prioritize physical continuity, consistent eye width and line weight, one connected shape per cel. No labels, letters, numbers, grid, panel borders, face, pupils, eyebrows or extra marks. This is opaque mint ink on pure white, like a simple printed sticker sheet.
accepted.review: White-background sheet accepted after visual comparison and connected component measurements. Arc retains polarity; loop keeps one connected stroke throughout closure and reopening; round adds two meaningful intermediates. Color has minor raster variation, background is near white. Use measured row boundaries and lower-lid registration, never per-frame scale. End every loop on frame 0, not frame 7.
limits: Not a complete redraw of all seven families.
These are cel assets; voice synchronization is outside this artwork audit.
Motion naturalness still requires inspection in renderer.
Pose 7 is an alternate open drawing, not a pixel-identical rest.
